title: Bürgeramt Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Three doors, not one.** Some Bürgeramt errands are online only, some can be walked in, and only the rest need a booked slot. Work out which door before you hunt for an appointment.
**A Meldebescheinigung is free online and 10 euros at the counter**, plus 5 euros for each extra family member on the same sheet. A register lookup is 5 euros online and 10 euros in person.

**26 of Berlin’s 38 Bürgeramt counters take a named list without an appointment:** Meldebescheinigung, Führungszeugnis, Gewerbezentralregisterauskunft, eID PIN resets, document collection and online-service advice.

**The eID chip is what unlocks the free online routes.** Activation and a PIN reset are **free, immediate and on that walk-in list**. EU citizens without a German ID can buy an eID-Karte for **37 euros**.

**ID cards and passports still need a slot:** **46 euros** for a Personalausweis from 24, **70 euros** for a Reisepass, 3 to 4 weeks and up to 8 weeks. You may book at any office in the city, not just your district.

**Registering a new address is free but timed:** **14 days** after moving in, and the federal registration act allows a fine of **up to 1,000 euros**. The online route needs BundID, an activated eID and German or EU citizenship.
